basis.text: IMPB1 note Theorem O3: exact compatibility polynomials Omega(+-c) at index 4; neither type compatible => no pole => constant (S Proposition 4.3); exactly one type c => the weight-2 polynomial R = v' + v^2/c + (a1/3) v has no pole and takes the value kappa = c(9a0 - 2a1^2)/18 at every pole, hence R = kappa by S Lemma lem:finite-values ("Bounded on the poles", project file l. 962; IMPORTED, agent-reviewed), so v solves a Riccati equation; both types => point transformation

basis.label: agent-proof
basis.text: Theorem P: Lemmas 5.1-5.5 of project note; eliminations for the two- and three-pole functions with symbolic theta (Singular, char 0). The cases r_i = 0 are Ng-Wu 2019 (Theorem 1.5, read by ORD2 in the local arXiv text) + demina_question Theorem 4.1 (re-proved); GENERAL section 4 proved that all solutions are group-type or twisted elliptic. The proof uses standard Nevanlinna tools (lemma on the logarithmic derivative, first main theorem), quoted and not read in this run. [LITCHECK: read: Ng-Wu 2019, Theorems 1.4-1.5 (pp. 5-6); Conte-Ng-Wu, Theorem 1 (p. 6)]

ruled_out.statement: Theorem P of project note: the nonconstant meromorphic solutions are exactly (1) fronts v' = A_i v^2 + B_i v + C_i when r_i = 0 (ORD2-P231-FRONT); (2) for A_i = 2 A_j, c + d A_i = 0: all solutions, v = -y'/(A_i y), y''' linear (ORD2-P231-COLEHOPF); (3) for A_j = -A_i/2, r_i = 0: logarithmic derivatives of the solutions of a type-(2,2,2) equation (ORD2-P231-FISHER-ELL, -TWIST0, -TWIST1); (4) for b = 0: all solutions if d = 0 (ORD2-P231-DUFFING-ELL) or if r_1 = r_2 = 0 (ORD2-P231-DUFFING-TWIST); (5) the two-pole waves on the codimension-two locus T (ORD2-P231-TWOPOLE). Elsewhere only constants (ORD2-P231-NOWAVE).
